name: Bicycle Crunch
steps: Lie flat on your back with your knees bent over your hips, shins parallel to the floor, and fingertips resting lightly behind your ears.
Brace your abs and lift your shoulder blades smoothly off the floor.
Rotate one shoulder toward your opposite bent knee while extending your other leg straight out just above the floor.
Switch smoothly through center toward the opposite side, continuing to alternate sides in a controlled pedaling rhythm.
tips: Rotate through your rib cage while letting your hands support your head without pulling on your neck.
Move with steady control rather than racing through floppy, rushed kicks.
